docs.title: Home
docs.answer: Home is where you start: paste a link or choose a video, then make clips.

docs.title: Jobs
docs.answer: Jobs shows every clip job and how far it is.

docs.title: Review
docs.answer: Review shows the clips waiting for you to keep or throw away.

docs.title: Library
docs.answer: Library shows all your clips and how they do.

docs.title: This week
docs.answer: This week shows the clips you posted this week.

docs.title: Clips
docs.answer: How many clips, and how long a video can be.

docs.title: How many clips
docs.answer: Clip Factory makes between your fewest and most clips each time.

docs.title: Longest video
docs.answer: For a longer video, only the first part is used.

docs.title: Skills
docs.answer: Teach Clip Factory how you like your clips.

docs.title: Add a skill
docs.answer: A SKILL.md file (up to 1 MB) or a .zip with one inside (up to 20 MB).

docs.title: Your skills
docs.answer: Skills that are on are used every time you make clips.

docs.title: YouTube help
docs.answer: For when YouTube blocks a video.

docs.title: YouTube cookies
docs.answer: You can skip this. Add them only if YouTube blocks a video.

docs.title: Accounts
docs.answer: The accounts your clips are posted to.

docs.title: Connected accounts
docs.answer: Connecting an account lets Clip Factory post your kept clips there. Coming in a later update.

docs.title: Where clips go
docs.answer: Pick the places your kept clips are posted.

docs.title: Post kept clips to
docs.answer: Pick at least one place.

docs.title: Sounds
docs.answer: Turn sounds on or off, and pick your two sounds.

docs.title: Sounds
docs.answer: Sounds only play when you tap, never when you scroll.

docs.title: Click sound
docs.answer: Plays when you tap something that works.

docs.title: Error sound
docs.answer: Plays when something can't be done.

docs.title: Try it
docs.answer: Hear your two sounds on a pretend Sign in button.

docs.title: Motion
docs.answer: Less moving around on the screen.

docs.title: Reduce motion
docs.answer: Turns off confetti, page moves and the moving background.

docs.title: Background
docs.answer: Your own picture behind the glass.

docs.title: Background picture
docs.answer: Use your own picture behind the glass. It stays on this device.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app
docs.answer: Open Clip Factory like any other app.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app
docs.answer: Put Clip Factory on this device, next to your other apps.

docs.title: Updates
docs.answer: Your version, and checking for a new one.

docs.title: This version
docs.answer: New versions arrive by themselves.

docs.title: Check for updates
docs.answer: Looks for a new version right now.

docs.title: Account
docs.answer: Who is signed in, and signing out.

docs.title: Signed in as
docs.answer: The email you use to sign in.

docs.title: Sign out
docs.answer: Signs you out of Clip Factory here.

docs.title: Make clips from a link
docs.answer: Paste a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link on Home and tap **Make clips**. Clip Factory finds the best moments for you.
steps: Tap **Paste** to put your link in the box.

docs.title: Make clips from your own video
docs.answer: Tap **Tap to choose a video** on Home, pick your file, then tap **Make clips**.

docs.title: Where is my job
docs.answer: Your job is on the **Jobs** page. It shows each step and how far it is. Most jobs take a few minutes.
steps: Tap your job to see its steps.

docs.title: When a job failed
docs.answer: Open the job and tap **Try again**. It starts over and uses the video it already saved.

docs.title: What Keep does
docs.answer: **Keep** sends the clip to be posted on your platforms. Nothing is posted until you tap **Keep**.

docs.title: Throw away a clip
docs.answer: Tap **Throw away** on Review and the clip is gone. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** within 8 seconds.
steps: Tap **Undo** if it was a mistake.

docs.title: Change a caption
docs.answer: Each platform has its own caption. Change it on Review before you tap **Keep**.
steps: Tap the platform under **Caption per platform**.

docs.title: When a post failed
docs.answer: If a post failed, open the clip on Review and tap **Try again**.
steps: Find the clip that says Failed.

docs.title: See how a clip is doing
docs.answer: Open **Library** and tap a clip. You see its views, likes and comments on each app.

docs.title: Refresh numbers
docs.answer: Numbers update by themselves. Tap **Refresh numbers** on a clip to check now. Instagram and Facebook can take 2 days.

docs.title: Star the best clips this week
docs.answer: In Library, open **This week** and tap the star on your favourite clips. Clip Factory learns from them.
steps: Tap the star on a clip.

docs.title: Views of my best clip this week
docs.answer: Your best clip is first in **This week**.

live.text: Your best clip this week got {value} views.

docs.title: Why my TikTok clip is private
docs.answer: TikTok shows posts privately until TikTok approves the app. The numbers come after that.

docs.title: Connect YouTube
docs.answer: Connecting YouTube is coming in a later update. It will be in Settings › Posting › Accounts.

docs.title: Connect Instagram
docs.answer: Connecting Instagram is coming in a later update. It will be in Settings › Posting › Accounts.

docs.title: Connect Facebook
docs.answer: Connecting Facebook is coming in a later update. It will be in Settings › Posting › Accounts.

docs.title: Connect TikTok
docs.answer: Connecting TikTok is coming in a later update. It will be in Settings › Posting › Accounts.

docs.title: Connect X
docs.answer: Connecting X is coming in a later update. It will be in Settings › Posting › Accounts.

docs.title: Choose where clips go
docs.answer: Pick the places your kept clips are posted. Pick at least one.

docs.title: Does X cost money
docs.answer: X charges a little each time Clip Factory checks a post's numbers. Clip Factory stops at $10 a month.

docs.title: Add a skill
docs.answer: Tap **Add a skill** and pick a SKILL.md file or a .zip with one inside.

docs.title: What a skill is
docs.answer: A skill teaches Clip Factory how you like your clips. All the AI in Clip Factory uses your skills that are on. Use the switch to turn one off.
steps: Use the switch to turn a skill on or off.

docs.title: Change the click sound
docs.answer: Open Sounds and pick a **Click sound**. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Tap a card to hear it and pick it.

docs.title: Change the error sound
docs.answer: Open Sounds and pick an **Error sound**. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Tap a card to hear it and pick it.

docs.title: Turn sounds off
docs.answer: Turn the **Sounds** switch off and Clip Factory stays quiet.

docs.title: Calmer screen and background
docs.answer: Turn on **Reduce motion** for a calmer screen. Pick a **Background picture** to put your own picture behind the glass.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Get the app on your computer
docs.answer: Get Clip Factory for your Mac or Windows computer and open it like any other app.
steps: Open the file and follow the steps.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Add Clip Factory to your iPhone
docs.answer: In Safari, tap **Share** and then **Add to Home Screen**.

docs.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
docs.title: Add Clip Factory to your Android phone
docs.answer: In Chrome, tap **Install app** to put Clip Factory on your home screen.

docs.title: Update the app
docs.answer: New versions arrive by themselves. When the update bar shows up, tap **Reload**. You can also tap **Check for updates**.

docs.title: When YouTube blocks a video
docs.answer: Sometimes YouTube says sign in to confirm you're not a bot. Then add your **YouTube cookies** file, and try again.

docs.title: How many clips are made
docs.answer: Clip Factory makes between your fewest and most clips each time. Change the numbers in **How many clips**.

docs.title: Clips waiting in Review
docs.answer: Open **Review** to keep or throw them away.

live.text: You have {value} clips waiting in Review.

docs.title: Jobs running now
docs.answer: Open **Jobs** to see them.

docs.title: Sign out
docs.answer: Open Account and tap **Sign out**.
